chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: The first trombone's fate and learning from an instruction book
summary: The trombone was later given to Eutris; he learned positions from a 15-cent instruction book.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: He gave it to me. He gave it to me in Cleveland. You came there with Fletcher Henderson.
Do you remember approximately what time it was?
I don't know what. I tried to play it; I played it for a while. He taught me a few notes.
You just got rid of it?
He got the trombone. Who started giving him instructions on the trombone?
He taught you the slide positions?
But he taught you - you had one or two lessons from him.

If that's what I told you the other night, Tuck Me to Sleep in. (told me to play) My Old Kentucky Home and I just played 8 bars. He didn't show me no positions. I paid 15¢ for an instruction book and got my positions from that. From the positions, then I went on for myself.
... You just taught yourself how to play, putting the mouthpiece on and everything?
Yes, put it on and started playing.
